description: This file defines the 'PaypalPayment' class, a subclass of 'Payment', representing a PayPal payment within the application. It includes attributes for 'payerId' and 'paymentToken', with corresponding getters and setters, and initializes the payment type to PayPal in the constructor.

classes.name: PaypalPayment
classes.description: Represents a PayPal payment, extending the Payment class with additional identifiers for payer and payment token.

methods.name: PaypalPayment
methods.description: Constructor that sets the payment type to PayPal.

methods.name: setPayerId
methods.description: Sets the payer's identifier for the PayPal transaction.

methods.name: setPaymentToken
methods.description: Sets the token associated with the PayPal payment.
